english_long: Nine (a spelled number in a name)
goldsmith (person with the seed-weight at his foot)
the rain season and its crop (a date head before -iṉ)
scabbard-fish (a counted fish good; also a crest "Bright-star" vāḷmīn)
stag, deer (the deer sign stands for the stag picture on copper tablets M-516, M-517)
kindred, family (the branching tree: kiḷai "to branch, multiply as families")
paddy field, farmland (grid with plants); with 421/423/424
rod, sceptre: mutal kōl "chief staff", an office
umbrella: a ruling house ("the quarter of the Umbrella")
shut in, stored, pledged (a closing word)
grain measure (a kalam); ship where it stands uncounted before the sail 500
Bloom (a name word: to abound, flower)
Leaf (a name word after a crest)
red-wood seed: a small goldsmith's weight (counted)
bow (vil-ampu vēḷ: chief of bow and arrow)
tusk, ivory (horn; the counted thing on elephant copper tablets)
